name: Inicios del Conflicto
source:
Inicios del Conflicto is a Visual Novel of romance and eroticism where you will take the role of Mitty, a fairy who was given an anecdotal task.

[Translated from [url=https://kuroshima60.itch.io/inicios-del-conflicto]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Inicios del Conflicto是一部浪漫和色情的视觉小说，你将扮演Mitty的角色，一位仙女，被赋予了一项轶事任务。

[译自[url=https://kuroshima60.itch.io/inicios-del-conflicto]Itch.io[/url]]
